## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[MyoAAV gene delivery preserves muscle in pancreatic cancer cachexia model](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.13.766453)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Preclinical evaluation of skeletal muscle-targeted MyoAAV vectors in orthotopic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (KPC) mouse models demonstrated that enhancing inner-mitochondrial membrane fusion (via `OPA1` overexpression) or suppressing mitophagy (via `BNIP3` knockdown) preserved muscle mass and force prior to systemic wasting.
* **[Distal convoluted tubule drives renal calcium loss in sickle cell disease](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.23.752598)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Single-cell multiomics in sickle cell disease (SCD) mouse models identified the distal convoluted tubule as the primary site of impaired renal calcium reabsorption, driven by suppression of calbindin 1 (`CALB1`) and disrupted Klotho-dependent `FGF23` signaling.
  * Dietary iron restriction exacerbated systemic calcium wasting by further downregulating renal `CALB1` and `SLC8A1` levels.
* **[Biotech]** **[IRAK4 inhibitor DW18134 overcomes ibrutinib resistance in DLBCL](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43039966/)** — *PubMed*
  * Preclinical studies showed that the novel IRAK4 inhibitor DW18134, evaluated in combination with BTK inhibitor ibrutinib, reversed acquired ibrutinib resistance and reduced disease burden in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma models.
* **[Epigenetic clock indicates Barrett's esophagus onset occurs decades prior to diagnosis](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.13.26367463)** — *medRxiv*
  * Application of a Barrett's esophagus (BE) epigenetic clock across population-based cohorts identified a median biological onset age of ~29 years (IQR = 20.4–45.8), establishing that non-dysplastic BE routinely persists for decades prior to clinical detection.
* **[Evaluation of agentic AI models reveals automation bias in prior authorization workflows](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.16.26355782)** — *medRxiv*
  * A benchmark of LLM browser agents (Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus 4.5) processing exome/genome sequencing prior authorization across 836 synthetic patient profiles demonstrated high task completion rates (93.7–95.5%) but severe automation bias, failing to withhold authorization on non-compliant requests (0% correct withholding rate for Gemini 3 Pro).
* **[Biotech]** **[Zymeworks outlines next-generation VEGF x PD-1 architecture](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2122629517038743560)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Zymeworks ($ZYME) detailed its proprietary structural approach to targeting the VEGF and PD-1 pathways, positioning the format as distinct from conventional bispecific antibodies ahead of a planned February 2027 R&D day.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[Capsida investigates risk mitigation following fatality in brain gene therapy trial](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/17/capsida-gene-therapy-trial-death-follow-up-investigation/)** — *STAT*
  * Following an unexpected patient death in a clinical trial evaluating an IV-administered AAV gene therapy engineered to cross the blood-brain barrier, Capsida Biotherapeutics is advancing updated dosing protocols and risk-mitigation measures to manage CNS target engagement safely.
* **[Big Pharma]** **[Merck's embibatinib response rates face scrutiny at ASH](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2122702749871808968)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Commentary from Enliven Therapeutics ($ELVN) highlighted a decrease in major molecular response (MMR) rates in maturing ASH abstract data for Merck’s allosteric BCR-ABL inhibitor embibatinib compared to earlier readouts.
* **[Prostatic urethral lift combined with SABR demonstrates safety in localized prostate cancer](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43039975/)** — *PubMed*
  * Phase I results (NCT05311527) established the feasibility and safety of combining a prostatic urethral lift implant with stereotactic ablative body radiotherapy in men with localized prostate cancer and co-occurring benign prostatic hyperplasia.
* **[Diazepam modulates threat processing in individuals at clinical high-risk for psychosis](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.12.26367443)** — *medRxiv*
  * A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled crossover trial demonstrated that acute challenge with 5 mg diazepam altered corticolimbic circuitry activation during facial emotion recognition tasks in antipsychotic-naive individuals at clinical high-risk for psychosis.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Novo Nordisk's semaglutide reduces BMI in pediatric obesity](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2604058)** — *NEJM*
  * Phase III data published in *The New England Journal of Medicine* showed that once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide met primary efficacy endpoints in pediatric patients aged 6 to <12 years with obesity, demonstrating superior BMI reduction compared to placebo.
* **[Biotech]** **[CG Oncology's cretostimogene cuts bladder cancer recurrence risk by 68%](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/cg-oncology-cretostimogene-adjuvant-bladder-cancer-results-pivot/874740/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Phase III trial data for cretostimogene grenadenorepvec, an intravesical oncolytic immunotherapy administered post-surgery in high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, met primary endpoints by reducing disease recurrence risk by 68%.
* **[Biotech]** **[Sellas Life Sciences reports overall survival benefit in AML trial](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/17/sellas-blood-cancer-immunotherapy-succeeds-clinical-trial/)** — *STAT*
  * Sellas Life Sciences ($SLS) announced that its Wilms tumor protein 1 (WT1)-targeting peptide immunotherapeutic, galinpepimut-S (GPS), achieved a statistically significant reduction in the risk of death in acute myeloid leukemia patients in pivotal testing.
* **[Biotech]** **[Ideaya updates mid-2027 timeline for Phase III Optimum-02 trial](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2122678164585599303)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Ideaya Biosciences ($IDYA) reiterated plans to report interim overall survival (OS) data from its pivotal Optimum-02 trial evaluating PKC inhibitor darovasertib in metastatic uveal melanoma by mid-2027, noting that initial FDA filings will include an early OS evaluation.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **[FDA approves Roche's novel oral breast cancer medicine](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/16/fda-approves-new-roche-breast-cancer-drug/)** — *STAT*
  * The FDA granted regulatory approval to Roche's oral breast cancer therapy, expanding options for HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced disease and establishing an asset projected as a core revenue driver for Roche's oncology franchise.
* **[Biotech]** **[FDA issues Complete Response Letter for Summit Therapeutics' ivonescimab](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/summit-akeso-fda-ivonescimab-reject-egfr-lung-cancer/874745/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * The FDA rejected Summit Therapeutics and Akeso’s BLA for ivonescimab (a PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody) in EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, declining to approve the application due to an initial failure to show an overall survival advantage.
* **[FDA proposes new regulatory category for N-acetylcysteine](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/16/fda-proposes-new-category-supplement-nac/)** — *STAT*
  * The FDA initiated a rulemaking process to establish a formal regulatory framework for N-acetylcysteine (NAC), aiming to resolve long-standing legal ambiguity regarding its status as a dietary supplement versus a drug substance.
* **[Biotech]** **[FDA accepts Karyopharm sNDA for Xpovio combination in myelofibrosis](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2122669137986236663)** — *X / BioStocks*
  * The FDA accepted Karyopharm Therapeutics' supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) for Xpovio (selinexor) in combination with ruxolitinib for patients with myelofibrosis.
  * The agency assigned a PDUFA target action date of June 28, 2027.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Johnson & Johnson acquires Ollin Therapeutics for $2.2B](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/Johnson-johnson-ollin-acquire-ophthalmology-vegf-ang2-drugs/874728/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Johnson & Johnson signed a definitive agreement to acquire Ollin Therapeutics for up to $2.2 billion, acquiring clinical-stage dual VEGF/Ang2 inhibitors to strengthen its late-stage ophthalmology pipeline.
* **[Biotech]** **[Isomorphic Labs secures $5B financing round](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/isomorphic-labs-ai-drug-discovery-financing/874863/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * AI-focused drug discovery platform Isomorphic Labs raised $5 billion in venture funding to expand its structural biology computational engine and accelerate internal drug discovery pipelines.
* **[Biotech]** **[Marrow Therapeutics launches with $173M for non-gene-therapy blood disease treatments](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/17/new-startup-developing-novel-sickle-cell-anemia-infusion-no-gene-therapy/)** — *STAT*
  * Marrow Therapeutics closed a $173 million Series A financing to advance infused disease-modifying therapies for sickle cell disease and beta-thalassemia, aiming to match the efficacy of ex vivo gene editing without toxic conditioning regimens.
* **[Flagship Pioneering launches AI biotech creation hub in London](https://x.com/bradloncar/status/2122456780387049674)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Venture firm Flagship Pioneering unveiled the Flagship Origination Lab in London, marking its first company-creation facility outside Cambridge, Mass., dedicated to building AI-native life science startups.
* **[Biotech index rebound demonstrates selective valuation gains](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/16/biotech-news-rebound-isnt-lifting-all-boats-equally/)** — *STAT*
  * Industry sector analysis notes that despite a broader macro recovery in biotech valuations, capital allocation remains highly concentrated, leaving many mid- and small-cap clinical data readouts without typical equity appreciation.
* **[Big Pharma]** **[Novo Nordisk launches Novocare platform for Wegovy support](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2122678263998996874)** — *X / BioStocks*
  * Novo Nordisk introduced Novocare, a free patient support program for individuals prescribed Wegovy (semaglutide).
  * The service provides home delivery connectivity, daily patient support, wellness partner access, and rewards programs.

## Public Health & Policy

* **[United States loses official measles elimination status](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/17/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-public-health-victory-lost/)** — *STAT*
  * Federal authorities confirmed the U.S. has lost its official measles elimination status following continuous endemic transmission lasting over 12 months, driven by dropping vaccine coverage rates.
  * Genomic surveillance of the 2025 Utah outbreak [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.13.26367651) (sequencing 66% of clinical cases) demonstrated that transmission clusters were heavily driven by institutional mixing in school settings.
* **[NIAID appoints John Powers III as permanent director](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/16/john-powers-appointed-niaid-director/)** — *STAT*
  * The National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases named acting head John Powers III as its permanent director, resolving leadership vacancies ongoing since 2025.
* **[Global access barriers highlighted for GLP-1 obesity therapies](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/16/semaglutide-obesity-glp1-access-medicines-low-income-countries/)** — *STAT*
  * Health economists and public health officials warned that manufacturing constraints and pricing for next-generation GLP-1 receptor agonists risk excluding low- and middle-income nations from obesity disease-management access.
* **[Federal court invalidates proposed visa restrictions on international researchers](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/16/judge-rejects-visa-limits-international-researchers-upholds-duration-of-status-policy/)** — *STAT*
  * A federal judge issued a final ruling striking down proposed federal regulations to cap student and scholar visa durations, preserving the established "duration of status" framework for international graduate students and postdocs.

**Worth watching:** Regulatory scrutiny regarding mature overall survival data requirements for novel bispecific constructs, highlighted by the FDA's Complete Response Letter for Summit Therapeutics' ivonescimab.
